artworks.title: Swiss Chalet
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The drawing shows a rural scene with a house, a body of water, and mountains in the background. The image conveys a serene atmosphere with a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Faut pas vous désoler comme ca ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of comical figures carrying a large grape on a stretcher. The image is in a cartoonish, satirical style. The drawing features two figures holding a massive grape covered in a blanket on a stretcher. In the background, there are faint illustrations of more figures and structures. The composition uses soft, sketchy lines to convey a humorous tone.

artworks.title: Study of Adam for the "Fifteen Mysteries of the Rosary"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a charcoal drawing of a person's upper legs and part of the torso in a seated position. The figure is dressed in loose-fitting clothing with folds and wrinkles. The drapery's texture is detailed, and the background is a plain, neutral shade.

artworks.title: Man with Curly Hair
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image features a pencil drawing of a man's head and upper torso in a three-quarter view, facing left. The subject's curly hair, mustache, and collared shirt are detailed with shading. The background is a plain beige. The numbers "1872" are inscribed in the top left and bottom right corners.

artworks.title: Studies for "Classic and Romantic Art"
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture of a figure with a muscular arm flexed behind its back. In front of the arm, there is a sculpted head of a lioness with rounded ears and pronounced facial features. The sketch is done in pencil, giving it a monochromatic appearance in shades of grey. The material of the sculpture is indeterminate, but the pencil shading creates a textured look. Next to the lioness's head is a detailed sketch of an intricate object resembling a tall, slender pedestal with spherical details. The composition emphasizes the human form on the left side, while the object and the lioness's head add detail on the right side.

artworks.title: Studies for "Gassed"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three full-body figures lying on the ground. The figures are in different reclined postures, with two on their sides and one on their back. They appear to have distinct facial features and are dressed in matching uniforms. The background is a plain, light-colored canvas, with no additional details present.

artworks.title: Studies of Aphrodite for "Aphrodite and Eros"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Study of the Crucifixion for "Fifteen Mysteries of the Rosary"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting two draped figures. One figure appears to be reclining, with their face turned downward and resting on their left arm. Their facial features are softly rendered, with a gentle expression. The figure's head is covered with fabric that drapes over their shoulders. The clothing is voluminous and covered in soft folds. The background is a blank beige tone, focusing solely on the figures' poses and drapery.

artworks.title: Study for "Triumph of Religion"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch that shows multiple people in dynamic poses, with minimal facial features and loosely defined clothing. On the right, a person is walking towards the right, holding an object resembling a cross in front of them. They are dressed in robes that billow out behind them, and they appear to have a feather or headdress on top of their head. Behind them seems to be another person also holding a cross, their back to us, although this could be a reflection of the central person. On the left, another person is partially visible behind a low table, their eyes closed and their face tilted upwards. The background is filled with dark shading and some other indistinguishable shapes. A large semi-circle in the top left is completely blank, giving the drawing an unusual shape.

artworks.title: Studies for "Two Classical Male Figures Wrestling"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of two male torsos. The top figure is shown from the back with emphasis on the muscular structure and broad shoulders, along with a suggestion of short hair. The lower figure is depicted in a side view from the waist up, highlighting the torso and arms. The lower figure's hand is shown gripping the wrist of the upper figure. Both figures are nude, and the sketch uses contours and shadows for detail. The background is plain, and the paper appears slightly aged.

artworks.title: Studies for "Gassed" [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two military figures in different poses. The figure on the left is depicted in a profile view facing left with his left arm extended, holding a rifle. The figure on the right is shown in a dynamic pose, with his back partly turned towards the viewer, and his right knee raised. Both figures wear military uniforms and are set against a plain background.

artworks.title: Studies for "Astronomy"
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person sitting in a relaxed position, with their body turned slightly to the side. Their legs are bent and tucked in, with one foot visible. They have their hands raised, with fingers partially extended. The person's facial features are softly drawn, with a gentle expression and slightly tilted head. Their hair is covered by a draped fabric, which is part of the clothing they wear. The clothing consists of loose, flowing garments with many folds, suggesting a robe or similar attire. The drawing is circular within a larger piece of paper, and a faint, smaller sketch of a seated figure is visible in the upper right corner outside the circle. The background of the main drawing is dark, creating a contrast with the figure, while the rest of the paper remains mostly blank and textured.

artworks.title: Study of Apollo for "Apollo and Daphne"
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person captured in a side profile. The individual is positioned dynamically, appearing to leap or run forward with one leg bent and the other extended behind. The arms are raised, with one hand splayed open and the other appearing slightly bent. The person's facial features are depicted in profile, showing a well-defined nose and lips with a neutral expression. The hair is styled back, possibly tied or slicked, giving a clear view of the profile. The figure is unclothed, emphasizing the anatomical structure and muscular definition. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a plain grid with no additional elements or context provided.

artworks.title: Studies for "Entering the War"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch featuring multiple head-and-shoulder portraits of men. The drawings focus on the men's faces, suggesting different angles and expressions. The facial features are highly detailed, showing strong jawlines, defined cheekbones, and pronounced eyebrows. The men have varied hairstyles. Some wear hats, and the clothing visible is limited to collars, suggesting they might be wearing uniforms. The background is plain, with no additional objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Studies for "Entering the War" [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of four soldiers walking from left to right. Each soldier is depicted in full-body, with simple outlines and wearing military helmets, uniforms, boots, and carrying backpacks and rifles.

artworks.title: Men Shoeing a Horse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stable scene with animals and objects. The sketch depicts a stable or barn area with a human figure near an animal, a horse, buckets, and a large circular object leaning against the wall. In the foreground, two small dogs are lounging on the ground. The drawing is in a monochromatic palette, using shading and lines for depth and texture in an expressive, informal style.

artworks.title: Studies for "Fumee d'Ambre Gris"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)

artworks.title: Study for "Handmaid of the Lord"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts the upper half of a figure with arms raised, possibly in the midst of pulling on or taking off a coat. The figure's head is blurred and shadowy. The coat has substantial volume, shaded folds, and creases indicating a thick texture. One sleeve is prominent while the other is slightly obscured by shadows. The sketching style is loose and gestural, focusing on capturing the flow and form of the fabric. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Studies of Generals Plumer and Haig for "General Officers of World War I" [recto]
artworks.medium: charcoal with graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body drawings of people standing upright. The person on the left is sketched with a slightly turned body position, holding a hat in their right hand, and wears a military-style uniform that includes a long-sleeved jacket, trousers, and a belt. The facial features are not detailed and appear as a basic outline, while the hair is short. The person on the right is also in a standing position with legs slightly apart, holding what seems to be a document or rolled paper in their left hand. This figure is also dressed in a military uniform with a long-sleeved jacket, trousers, and a belt. The facial features of this drawing are minimally detailed, and the hair is short. The background is a plain, neutral space with the canvas showing a slightly aged appearance.

artworks.title: Study of General Louis Botha for "General Officers of World War I"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a person standing upright. The person has their arms crossed over their chest and their legs slightly apart. The facial features are roughly sketched, showing a prominent nose and mouth. The individual is dressed in a jacket, trousers, knee-high boots, a belt, and a rope or cord hanging from the waist. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Gondolier, Venice
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person viewed from behind. The sketch shows the upper body from the torso upwards. The person is standing or possibly leaning forward, with their left arm on a surface indicated by a line beside them. The person has short hair and wears a loose jacket with folds on the back. No jewelry or objects are depicted. The background is plain with a light-colored surface. The sketch focuses on using lines and shading to depict the person's form and clothing.

artworks.title: Pines
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a natural scene with a rocky terrain and trees viewed from a slightly elevated angle. A large rock formation is centered in the drawing, surrounded by tall, slender trees. The sky above includes soft clouds, all rendered in a monochromatic color palette of gray, black, and beige.

artworks.title: Bellosguardo, Florence
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The drawing shows a landscape with terraced fields, trees, shrubs, and hills. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, allowing for a clear view. The horizon is high in the picture. The pencil strokes are soft, creating a detailed texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black, gray, and beige tones.

artworks.title: On Green River
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image is an oval-shaped, black-and-white sketch of a landscape viewed from a side perspective. A tree is on the left, with branches covered in leaves. A body of water reflects the scene. Hills with trees are in the distance. The technique uses shading and line work to create texture and depth, emphasizing the tranquil mood. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on light and shadow.
